description.value: A family-run greenhouse operation on Glanford Ave that has been growing produce at this site since the 1920s, with the current family farming here since 1960. The roadside stand sells a broad range of greenhouse and garden vegetables — tomatoes, cucumbers, peppers, eggplants, kale, beans, herbs, and more — direct from the farm. Cyclists passing through the Saanich area can stop in to stock up on fresh local produce, and the farm also appears at several Greater Victoria farmers markets throughout the season.
